blocks.text: Sampai sekarang kamu bicara tentang saat ini: I am at home. Sekarang kamu belajar bercerita tentang masa lalu: «kemarin aku di rumah», «saat Natal kami bersama», «di tas ada dua jepit jemuran». Bahasa Inggris mengubah penjepitnya ke bentuk lampau.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
We were together at Christmas.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Di tas ada dua jepit jemuran.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?

blocks.text: Kita cukup menambah «kemarin», kata lainnya tidak berubah. Bahasa Inggris harus berubah: am dan is jadi was, are jadi were. I was, she was — you were, we were, they were. Jangan bilang Yesterday I am.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
She was in London last year.
We were at home last night.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: Saat Tahun Baru mereka di London.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

drill.why: Dengan we di masa lalu — were.

sections.title: Tanda masa lalu: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Biasanya ada kata yang menunjukkan masa lalu: yesterday — «kemarin», last night — «tadi malam», last year — «tahun lalu». Hari raya pakai at: at Christmas, at New Year. Hari pakai on: on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
We were together at Christmas.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: Saat Tahun Baru mereka di London.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

fixes.wrong: We were together in Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: Kalau tentang kemarin — was atau were. Kalau tentang sekarang — is atau are, seperti sebelumnya. Kata yesterday atau now langsung memberi petunjuk: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
The shower curtain is dry now.
The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Kemarin handuknya basah. Kamu bilang apa?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
drill.explain: Kemarin adalah masa lalu, jadi was.

sections.title: Yang tidak dihitung per buah — was

blocks.text: Seperti di pelajaran 4, yang tidak dihitung per buah — krim, makanan, jus — memakai bentuk tunggal: was, bukan were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Kemarin tabir surya ada di tasku.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: «Tidak» ditaruh tepat sesudah was atau were: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Bukan It not was.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.
The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: Selai kacangnya tidak ada di meja.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Kita bertanya tanpa mengubah urutan. Bahasa Inggris memindahkan was atau were ke depan: Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Jawaban singkat juga dengan penjepit: Yes, it was. Tidak pakai did.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: Saat musim gugur kamu di rumah?

examples.en: Was your pancake hot?
Were the scrambled eggs hot?
Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

sections.title: «Ada» di masa lalu: there was, there were

blocks.text: Kita bilang «ada» untuk sekarang dan masa lalu. Bahasa Inggris berubah: There was untuk satu benda, There were untuk banyak. There was a towel rail in the bathroom. There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: Di tas ada dua jepit jemuran.

examples.en: There was a public toilet near the station.
There were two taxi drivers near the station.
examples.translation: Dekat stasiun ada dua sopir taksi.

examples.en: There was fruit salad in the bowl.

fixes.wrong: There are two clothes pegs in the bag yesterday.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

drill.after: two duvet covers in the cupboard.
drill.why: Sarung selimutnya dua, jadi There were.

blocks.text: Dengan was mudah menilai sesuatu yang sudah lewat: That was a silly idea — «itu ide konyol», The plan was sensible — «rencananya masuk akal». Untuk banyak benda — were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
The plan was sensible.
The rules were fair.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Seluruh tata bahasa baru di pelajaran ini cuma dua bentuk: was untuk I, he, she, it, dan satu benda; were untuk you, we, they, dan banyak benda. Sisanya sama seperti am, is, are.
Dulu — was atau were. Tidak — was not, were not. Bertanya — Was…? Were…?, jawab — Yes, it was. Dulu ada — There was / There were. Kemarin — was, sekarang — is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
It was not my day off.
Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: Saat musim gugur kamu di rumah?

examples.en: There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
examples.translation: Di samping wastafel ada tempat sabun.
